learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will travel across big mountains, hot deserts, and green plains to see how people live differently!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Mountains are very high areas of land and it is usually very cold up there! Houses often have sloping roofs so snow can slide off, and people wear thick woolen clothes to stay warm.
Deserts are dry places with lots of sand and very little rain. Camels help people travel here, and houses have very thick walls to keep the hot sun outside.
Plains are large, flat areas of land. The soil here is wonderful for growing crops like wheat and rice. Because it is easy to build roads and houses on flat land, many people live in plains!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Pack Your Bags Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are going on a trip to a snowy mountain. Draw a suitcase and fill it with 3 things you must pack, like a heavy jacket, a warm cap, and thick boots!

quick_recap: ⭐ The shape of the land and the weather changes how people build houses and dress.
⭐ Mountains are cold, deserts are hot and dry, and plains are flat and good for farming.
⭐ Different lands have different amazing animals, like yaks in the cold and camels in the desert.
